backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing user profiles, settings, and session tracking with access control and custom pet type comparisons.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature requests to affected frontend files and related components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file for reference or tooling.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base configuration defining light/dark theme color variables and global styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting favicon, manifest, root container, and loading the React app.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: Web app manifest configuring PWA metadata and icon assets for the application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component handling authentication, screen navigation, session lifecycle, mood, and dialogue state.
frontend/src/components/AppShell.tsx: Layout wrapper providing header, navigation, background rendering, and footer for all screens.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Handles Internet Identity login/logout with UI feedback and error handling.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: A dialog prompting users to enter and save their name for profile setup.
frontend/src/components/DistractedCheckI: A dialog that lets users select a distraction platform and submit it, using saved user settings when available.
frontend/src/components/MoodIndicator.ts: Displays a mood badge for a pet with mood-specific colors and labels based on pet type.
frontend/src/components/PetOverlay.tsx: Renders a movable pet sprite that follows the pointer, shows dialogue, and supports muting.
frontend/src/components/petSprites.ts: Selects the correct pet sprite frame from a sprite sheet based on pet type and mood.
frontend/src/components/RewardActionsBar: Shows action buttons (feed, groom, pet, play) with icons and triggers callbacks on click.
frontend/src/components/SessionSummaryPa: Displays a summary of session configuration including durations, cycles, pet type, and tasks.
frontend/src/components/SpeechBubble.tsx: A styled speech bubble card that displays dialogue text with a pointer tail.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to user identity, refreshing dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, login handling, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/usePointerFollow.ts: Provides a hook that tracks pointer movement with smoothing and clamps position to the viewport.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for loading and saving user profiles, settings, and session data via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base setup defining light/dark theme CSS variables and utility styles such as pixel-art rendering.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with query client and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/screens/ActiveSessionScreen: Displays the active focus session timer with pause/resume, end session actions, and distraction check-ins.
frontend/src/screens/BreakRewardScreen.t: Shows the break screen, saves completed sessions, displays break timer, and provides pet reward actions.
frontend/src/screens/ProgressSettingsScr: Loads user progress and settings, displays session history, and allows modifying and saving user preferences.
Allows users to configure and start a new session using saved defaults, selecting pet type, durations, and tasks.
frontend/src/state/dialogue.ts: Defines dialogue sets for cat and dog moods and provides a function to fetch a random line based on pet type and mood.
frontend/src/state/mood.ts: Defines mood tiers and thresholds for cats and dogs and computes the correct mood based on interruption duration.
frontend/src/state/rewardReactions.ts: Returns short pet reaction strings based on pet type and reward action.
frontend/src/state/sessionTypes.ts: Defines session configuration structure and session phase types.
frontend/src/state/useBehaviorMonitoring: Tracks user inactivity, tab visibility, and manual interruptions to accumulate interruption duration.
frontend/src/state/useCountdownTimer.ts: Provides a countdown timer hook with start, pause, resume, stop, and reset controls.
frontend/src/state/useDialogueController: Generates and periodically updates dialogue for a pet based on mood and session phase.
frontend/src/state/useMoodController.ts: Determines and updates the pet’s current mood using interruption duration and activity state.
Manages focus-break session flow, timers, and state transitions including interruptions.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters and sessionStorage-persisted values.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS theme extensions, plugins, and design tokens for the project.
project_state.json: Contains project metadata, design notes, issues, required images, and a list of implemented features for the 'Your Desk Pet' productivity app. Defines architectural constraints and identifies current bugs related to pet overlay and duplicate pets.
